result._raw: A Kerberos Golden Ticket attack was detected. Account: svc_backup@PROD.CORP.COM requested a TGT with unusually long lifetime (99999 minutes) from Domain Controller DC-01. This is indicative of a forged Ticket Granting Ticket (TGT) commonly used for persistent domain persistence. Source Workstation: WORKSTATION-7 (10.10.5.22).
